errors.text_span: съдържа шест визуални сектора, съответстващи на шест възрастови групи
errors.evidence: The description states there are six sectors and six age groups, but the pie chart clearly shows seven sectors and the legend lists seven age groups (14-17, 18-24, 25-34, 35-44, 45-54, 55-64, 65+). The description itself proceeds to list all seven groups, contradicting its initial statement.

errors.text_span: а секторът за възрастовата група 14-17 години е изобразен с тъмносин цвят и заема 5%
errors.evidence: The description assigns the color "тъмносин" (dark blue) to the 14-17 age group (5% slice). However, in the chart, the 14% slice (65+) is dark blue, while the 5% slice (14-17) is a distinctly different, lighter shade of blue. The description incorrectly uses the same color name for two different colors.

errors.text_span: секторите са подредени по низходящ размер, започвайки от най-големия (25-34) и завършвайки с най-малкия (14-17)
errors.evidence: The description claims the sectors are arranged in descending order of size. This is incorrect. Following the slices clockwise from the largest (20%), the percentage values are 20%, 17%, 16%, 15%, 14%, 5%, 13%. This sequence is not descending, as 5% is followed by 13%.
